scenario.name: mixed-race town trains construction worker
preconditions: town has at least two distinct race IDs
selected race has at least one jobless resident
treasury is sufficient for the selected training action
actionSequence: advance original game-day clock until training finishes
failureCasesToVerify: insufficient treasury must not silently discard queued request
selected race with no jobless residents must not debit another race
save/load during active training preserves selected race and remaining time

evidenceRequiredBeforeParityClaim: identify exact WASM build commit and checksum
capture C++/WASM initial state and game-day count
record observed treasury and race population deltas
capture construction worker skill/race after completion
compare HTML outputs with original under same initial state
notes: Reference candidate only. This is an executable-test input contract, NOT an observed golden output or evidence of parity.
